queries: WITH rates AS (SELECT m.Name AS Name, SUM(t.Bytes) * 1.0 / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS rate FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.Name) SELECT Name, rate, rate / (SELECT AVG(rate) FROM rates) AS rate_relative_to_mean FROM rates

WITH r AS (SELECT m.Name AS Name, CAST(SUM(t.Bytes) AS REAL) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS Rate FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name) SELECT Name, Rate, Rate / (SELECT AVG(Rate) FROM r) AS RateRelativeToMean FROM r

responses.sql: WITH rates AS (SELECT m.Name AS Name, SUM(t.Bytes) * 1.0 / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS rate FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.Name) SELECT Name, rate, rate / (SELECT AVG(rate) FROM rates) AS rate_relative_to_mean FROM rates

assumptions.assumption: Media types are grouped by name, and the 'simple mean' is taken over the per-name rates. Media types with no tracks have no rate, so they are left out of the mean. Names are assumed unique in MediaType.
SUM(Bytes) skips NULL Bytes, while SUM(Milliseconds) still counts those tracks. This follows the request's wording of summing each column over all of a type's tracks.
Multiplying by 1.0 avoids integer division, so nothing is rounded.

responses.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT m.Name AS Name, CAST(SUM(t.Bytes) AS REAL) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS Rate FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name) SELECT Name, Rate, Rate / (SELECT AVG(Rate) FROM r) AS RateRelativeToMean FROM r

assumptions.assumption: Inner join of Track to MediaType, so media types with no tracks are excluded and are not counted in the mean of rates. Each remaining media type is counted once.
The sum of Bytes ignores NULL Bytes, while the sum of Milliseconds includes every track. Tracks with NULL Bytes are not excluded from the denominator.
The sum of Bytes is cast to a real number to avoid integer division. Nothing is rounded.

responses.sql: WITH rates AS (SELECT m.Name AS Name, CAST(SUM(t.Bytes) AS REAL) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS Rate FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.Name) SELECT Name, Rate, Rate / (SELECT AVG(Rate) FROM rates) AS RateRelativeToMean FROM rates

assumptions.assumption: Media types are grouped by name, as the request says. Media types with no tracks never appear, because tracks are inner-joined to media types. The mean is therefore taken over media types that have at least one track.
Tracks with NULL Bytes add nothing to the byte total, but their Milliseconds still count in the denominator. This is the default SUM behavior.
